theme.title: NBA Mix 09
theme.subtitle: Five moments from across NBA history
theme.recap: Five NBA stories, five different numbers: a quick tour of stars, teams, records and surprises.

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did Dwight Howard's 2008–09 Magic win?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)

questions.prompt: How many points per game did Kawhi Leonard score during the Raptors' 2019 playoffs?
questions.context: Toronto · entire 2019 postseason, not just Finals
questions.note: 30.5 per game across Toronto's championship postseason.

funFacts.text: Leonard started every Toronto playoff game and logged 939 minutes during the run.
Toronto rallied from a two-game series deficit by winning four straight against Milwaukee.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: winning the last four games of the series after being down 0–2

funFacts.text: The Raptors became the first team based outside the United States to win the NBA championship.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: first non-US team to win the NBA title

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: scoring 13 points in the final 35 seconds against the San Antonio Spurs

funFacts.text: Houston acquired McGrady from Orlando in a seven-player deal that also sent Steve Francis and Cuttino Mobley away.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: McGrady, Juwan Howard, Tyronn Lue, and Reece Gaines were traded to the Houston Rockets as part of a seven-player deal

questions.prompt: Of the 288 possible minutes in the six-game 1986 Finals, how many did Larry Bird play?
questions.context: 1986 NBA Finals · six games vs Houston
questions.note: 269, resting for only 19 minutes all series.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Bird got very little rest during the six-game series, logging 269 out of a possible 288 minutes of floor time.

funFacts.text: Scott Wedman's wrist injury reduced Boston's wing depth and helped explain Bird's huge Finals workload.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: With backup forward Scott Wedman sidelined due to a wrist injury

funFacts.text: Reserve Bill Walton made a crucial basket late in Game 4 while Robert Parish rested.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: with Bill Walton coming off the bench for a tired Robert Parish to score a crucial basket

funFacts.text: The fifth Finals game erupted when Ralph Sampson clashed with the much shorter Jerry Sichting and was ejected.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Ralph Sampson ignited a brawl with Jerry Sichting, a player 15 inches (380 mm) shorter than Sampson
